_about: T23 self-test. Nodes written against the fixture_115 corpus (fictional text). Two are clean; eight carry one planted error each. Expectations map node ID to the planted error type, or null for a clean node. The packets never show this file.

nodes.title: The wooden token
rubric: A fictional box contains a widget-shaped wooden token.
Fixture Co paints a green stripe on the wooden token.
The imaginary stripe has no effect outside this fixture.
nodes.canonical_explanation: The stripe on the wooden token matters only inside this fixture.
misconceptions: The stripe on the wooden token is painted red.

nodes.title: The cabinet bell
rubric: Fixture Co keeps a pretend orange widget in a glass cabinet.
The bell stays silent when the cabinet is opened.
The bell sound is represented by a paper star.
Fixture Co stores that star in an imaginary drawer.
nodes.canonical_explanation: The glass cabinet holds the orange widget.

nodes.title: Widget notes
rubric: Fixture Co groups its imaginary widget notes.
The first note describes a pretend brass widget.
nodes.canonical_explanation: The widget notes are grouped by Fixture Co.

nodes.title: Painting the token
rubric: A fictional box contains a widget-shaped wooden token.
Fixture Co paints a green stripe on the wooden token, except on tokens stored in a cardboard moon.
The imaginary stripe has no effect outside this fixture.
nodes.canonical_explanation: The wooden token carries a green stripe.

nodes.title: The purple label
rubric: A made-up label identifies a purple widget.
nodes.canonical_explanation: A label is used to identify the purple widget.

nodes.title: The glass cabinet
rubric: Fixture Co keeps a pretend orange widget in a glass cabinet.

nodes.title: When the bell rings
rubric: Fixture Co keeps a pretend orange widget in a glass cabinet.

nodes.canonical_explanation: The bell marks each opening of the cabinet.
